# Cyber Ad Space

> Cyber Ad Space (CyberAdSpace) builds brands and websites with AI, guided by people. It sells a $350 Brand Starter and custom builds quoted in writing, runs the CyberAdSpace Marketplace, and created every brand listed below.

Contact: Contact@CyberAdSpace.com

## Services

- [Brand Starter, $350 one time](https://cyberadspace.com/start): 5 brand name options with a domain availability check and a basic trademark search; logo (main, icon and black-and-white); brand kit (colors, fonts, tagline, brand story); one-page website hosted for you; Marketplace storefront with up to 5 products; launch kit (5 social posts, profile image and banner); 2 rounds of revisions; delivered within 72 hours of payment. AI builds each piece and a person reviews it. Domain not included (about $12-$20 a year). No sales or income are promised.
- [Custom builds](https://cyberadspace.com/#pricing): multi-page websites, custom AI features like a Q&A assistant, marketplaces and booking platforms, and rebrands. Fixed quote in writing before work begins.
- [Run one of our brands](https://cyberadspace.com/#operators): some brands are looking for an operator who runs it and keeps the large majority of what it earns, under a private written agreement.
- [CyberAdSpace Marketplace](https://cyberadspace.com/marketplace): brands created through CyberAdSpace and their products. 3.5% fee only on sales made through the Marketplace.
- [Moon base](https://cyberadspace.com/live): every brand in its dome and the AI agents that build new brands, working live.
